chunks.title: HSBC (HSBC) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: HSBC is a Global Commercial Bank headquartered in United Kingdom. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Prominent international banking delegation at COP31 Antalya (19 accredited delegates) focused on transition finance & green supply chains. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Global sustainable finance & investment mobilization ($750B–$1T 2030 target) across green trade, supply chain decarbonization & transition loans. Source verification: https://thefederal.com/the-federal-special/cop31-in-antalya-big-polluters-and-climate-activists-under-one-roof-262803.

chunks.title: HSBC Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: HSBC provides the following climate financing instruments: Green Trade Finance, Sustainability-Linked Loan (SLL), Green Bond Underwriting, Transition Finance Facility, Supply Chain Decarbonization Finance. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 10,000,000 to USD 500,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Large Corporate, Mid-Cap Enterprise, Project SPV, Financial Intermediary.

chunks.title: HSBC Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by HSBC: Industrial Decarbonization, Renewable Energy, Sustainable Supply Chains, Climate-Tech Innovation, Green Buildings, Clean Transport. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Asia-Pacific, Europe, MENA, Türkiye, Americas. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: HSBC Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete HSBC's application form: HSBC Sustainable Finance & Transition Framework alignment; Measurable Scope 1/2/3 KPIs & LMA/APLMA GLP/SLLP structuring; Second-Party Opinion (SPO) or third-party verification; Corporate creditworthiness & ESG controversy screening. Explicit exclusion rules: New thermal coal power/mines; New oil & gas fields. Official application portal: https://www.business.hsbc.com/en-gb/solutions/sustainable-finance.

chunks.title: HSBC Form Template: Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake
chunks.text: HSBC uses the 'Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake' workflow governed by LMA/APLMA Green Loan Principles (GLP), Sustainability-Linked Loan Principles (SLLP) & ICMA GBP. Typical review timeline is 3–8 weeks (Sustainable Finance Structuring -> Credit Committee -> Syndication/Close). Form sections required: 1. Borrower Overview, 2. Structuring, 3. Transition Credibility, 4. Risk & Underwriting, 5. Mandate Pitch.
